name: particles-curation
description: Curate a Particles store from a pane beside the chat, and see a contested belief's card when the agent uses it.

engineUrl.title: Engine URL
engineUrl.description: The Particles engine to curate. A non-loopback engine must use https.

engineToken.title: Engine key
engineToken.description: A per-client key minted for this pane (particles engine keys). The operator role lets the pane act on cards; a reader key gives a read-only pane. Leave empty for a keyless engine on this machine.

mcpServer.title: Particles MCP server name
mcpServer.description: The name the Particles MCP server is registered under, used to see contested beliefs in the agent's queries.

reviewerId.title: Reviewer id
reviewerId.description: Recorded on each conflict you resolve from the pane.
